newsitem.title: GERMANY: TABLE-Dresdner H1 oper profit up 23 percent.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Dresdner H1 oper profit up 23 percent.

text.p: (in millions of marks unless otherwise stated)
Group oper profit after provs (more than) 1,700 up 23 pct
NOTE - Full name of the German bank is Dresdner Bank AG. Earnings compare with first half of 1996.
The figure was released ahead of the bank's interim results news conference in Berlin on Tuesday.

Banking analysts polled by Reuters had on average predicted an operating profit after risk provisions of 1.67 billion marks, a rise of 17.9 percent. Forecasts ranged from 1.6 billion to 1.8 billion marks.
The bank also said it planned to raise its base capital by 120 million marks by issuing new shares in the ratio one for 20 held. The shares would be entitled to a dividend from July 1 1997.
Dresdner said it expected the subscription period for the issue would be from August 14 to August 28. The price would be set shortly before, taking into account current market conditions.
Dresdner said the step was primarily designed to increase its leeway for strategic measures. It was not more specific.
The capital measure is subject to approval from the supervisory board.
